dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: How could a divinity like Rex Lapis die? Even though I witnessed it myself, I can't believe it.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: He must've just moved back to Celestia. I mean, many of his old adepti pals are still there, right?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: As for Liyue, I'm sure he's made thorough arrangements... Why, you ask?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Well, I've lived in my hometown for several decades now, and I sure did miss home a few times while I was here for the Rite...

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis has been with us for thousands of years... I'm sure he'll miss us, too.
